rendered:
The document does not say that S. aureus had the lowest limit of detection, and it gives no LOD value for S. aureus. The main text states only that CD consistently achieved lower limit of detection[1] (LOD) than UV–vis. The only LOD values it reports are for P. aeruginosa and L. monocytogenes: P. aeruginosa had an LOD of OD600 =0.0034 (CD,[2] and for L. monocytogenes it was presented an LOD of 0.0123 (CD, Fig. S17c)[3]. The supporting LOD plots are in the supplementary figures, which are not reproduced in this document, so no reason for an S. aureus LOD can be given from it.

The only related S. aureus observation is a signal-size reading from the sensor-array figure: Fig. 2[4] reports that S. aureus gave the smallest magnitude[5] of CD difference among the bacteria. That is a model-read reading of the figure, and the document does not connect it to any detection limit, so it cannot be taken as the explanation.
